statement: ∀ (a : ℂ), a ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) → a ≠ 0 → ∀ (b : ℂ), b ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) → ∃ q : ℚ, b = (q : ℂ) * a
proof:
intro a ha ha0 b hb
rcases h_T012.1 with ⟨μ, hμ, hμinj, hμrange⟩
let A : ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0) := 1 ⊗ₜ[R p] (⟨a, ha⟩ : J p M (ev y v 0))
let B : ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0) := 1 ⊗ₜ[R p] (⟨b, hb⟩ : J p M (ev y v 0))
have hA : μ A = a := by
  simpa [A] using hμ 1 ⟨a, ha⟩
have hB : μ B = b := by
  simpa [B] using hμ 1 ⟨b, hb⟩
have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  apply ha0
  rw [← hA, hz, map_zero]
obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one h_T013 hA0 B
have hqC : q • a = b := by
  simpa only [map_smul, hA, hB] using congrArg μ hq
exact ⟨q, by simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, eq_comm] using hqC⟩
